paragraphs.text: And in those days cometh John the Baptist, preaching in the wilderness of Judaea, saying,
paragraphs.original: Ἐν δὲ ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις παραγίνεται Ἰωάννης ὁ βαπτιστὴς κηρύσσων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῆς Ἰουδαίας
paragraphs.translit: En de tais hēmerais ekeinais paraginetai Iōannēs ho baptistēs kēryssōn en tē erēmō tēs Ioudaias

paragraphs.text: Repent ye; for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.
paragraphs.original: καὶ λέγων· Μετανοεῖτε, ἤγγικεν γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai legōn· Metanoeite, ēngiken gar hē basileia tōn ouranōn.

paragraphs.text: For this is he that was spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make ye ready the way of the Lord, Make his paths straight.
paragraphs.original: οὗτος γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ῥηθεὶς διὰ Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος· Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: houtos gar estin ho rhētheis dia Ēsaiou tou prophētou legontos· Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō· Hetoimasate tēn hodon kyriou, eutheias poieite tas tribous autou.

paragraphs.text: Now John himself had his raiment of camel`s hair, and a leathern girdle about his loins; and his food was locusts and wild honey.
paragraphs.original: αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάννης εἶχεν τὸ ἔνδυμα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τριχῶν καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, ἡ δὲ τροφὴ ἦν αὐτοῦ ἀκρίδες καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.
paragraphs.translit: autos de ho Iōannēs eichen to endyma autou apo trichōn kamēlou kai zōnēn dermatinēn peri tēn osphyn autou, hē de trophē ēn autou akrides kai meli agrion.

paragraphs.text: Then went out unto him Jerusalem, and all Judaea, and all the region round about the Jordan;
paragraphs.original: τότε ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἱεροσόλυμα καὶ πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία καὶ πᾶσα ἡ περίχωρος τοῦ Ἰορδάνου,
paragraphs.translit: tote exeporeueto pros auton Hierosolyma kai pasa hē Ioudaia kai pasa hē perichōros tou Iordanou,

paragraphs.text: and they were baptized of him in the river Jordan, confessing their sins.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ebaptizonto en tō Iordanē potamō hypʼ autou exomologoumenoi tas hamartias autōn.

paragraphs.text: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said unto them, Ye offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?
paragraphs.original: Ἰδὼν δὲ πολλοὺς τῶν Φαρισαίων καὶ Σαδδουκαίων ἐρχομένους ἐπὶ τὸ βάπτισμα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν, τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς;
paragraphs.translit: Idōn de pollous tōn Pharisaiōn kai Saddoukaiōn erchomenous epi to baptisma autou eipen autois· Gennēmata echidnōn, tis hypedeixen hymin phygein apo tēs mellousēs orgēs;

paragraphs.text: Bring forth therefore fruit worthy of repentance:
paragraphs.original: ποιήσατε οὖν καρπὸν ἄξιον τῆς μετανοίας
paragraphs.translit: poiēsate oun karpon axion tēs metanoias

paragraphs.text: and think not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μὴ δόξητε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς· Πατέρα ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ, λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι δύναται ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τῶν λίθων τούτων ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ.
paragraphs.translit: kai mē doxēte legein en heautois· Patera echomen ton Abraam, legō gar hymin hoti dynatai ho theos ek tōn lithōn toutōn egeirai tekna tō Abraam.

paragraphs.text: And even now the axe lieth at the root of the trees: every tree therefore that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.
paragraphs.original: ἤδη δὲ ἡ ἀξίνη πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων κεῖται· πᾶν οὖν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καρπὸν καλὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ εἰς πῦρ βάλλεται.
paragraphs.translit: ēdē de hē axinē pros tēn rhizan tōn dendrōn keitai· pan oun dendron mē poioun karpon kalon ekkoptetai kai eis pyr balletai.

paragraphs.text: I indeed baptize you in water unto repentance: but he that cometh after me is mightier than I, whose shoes I am not worthy to bear: he shall baptize you in the Holy Spirit and [in] fire:
paragraphs.original: Ἐγὼ μὲν ὑμᾶς βαπτίζω ἐν ὕδατι εἰς μετάνοιαν· ὁ δὲ ὀπίσω μου ἐρχόμενος ἰσχυρότερός μού ἐστιν, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς τὰ ὑποδήματα βαστάσαι· αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς βαπτίσει ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ καὶ πυρί·
paragraphs.translit: Egō men hymas baptizō en hydati eis metanoian· ho de opisō mou erchomenos ischyroteros mou estin, hou ouk eimi hikanos ta hypodēmata bastasai· autos hymas baptisei en pneumati hagiō kai pyri·

paragraphs.text: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing-floor; and he will gather his wheat into the garner, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.
paragraphs.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ διακαθαριεῖ τὴν ἅλωνα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνάξει τὸν σῖτον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἀποθήκην, τὸ δὲ ἄχυρον κατακαύσει πυρὶ ἀσβέστῳ.
paragraphs.translit: hou to ptyon en tē cheiri autou, kai diakathariei tēn halōna autou kai synaxei ton siton autou eis tēn apothēkēn, to de achyron katakausei pyri asbestō.

paragraphs.text: Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to the Jordan unto John, to be baptized of him.
paragraphs.original: Τότε παραγίνεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας ἐπὶ τὸν Ἰορδάνην πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην τοῦ βαπτισθῆναι ὑπʼ αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: Tote paraginetai ho Iēsous apo tēs Galilaias epi ton Iordanēn pros ton Iōannēn tou baptisthēnai hypʼ autou.

paragraphs.text: But John would have hindered him, saying, I have need to be baptized of thee, and comest thou to me?
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰωάννης διεκώλυεν αὐτὸν λέγων· Ἐγὼ χρείαν ἔχω ὑπὸ σοῦ βαπτισθῆναι, καὶ σὺ ἔρχῃ πρός με;
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iōannēs diekōlyen auton legōn· Egō chreian echō hypo sou baptisthēnai, kai sy erchē pros me;

paragraphs.text: But Jesus answering said unto him, Suffer [it] now: for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness. Then he suffereth him.
paragraphs.original: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν· Ἄφες ἄρτι, οὕτως γὰρ πρέπον ἐστὶν ἡμῖν πληρῶσαι πᾶσαν δικαιοσύνην. τότε ἀφίησιν αὐτόν.
paragraphs.translit: apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen pros auton· Aphes arti, houtōs gar prepon estin hēmin plērōsai pasan dikaiosynēn. tote aphiēsin auton.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus when he was baptized, went up straightway from the water: and lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming upon him;
paragraphs.original: βαπτισθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εὐθὺς ἀνέβη ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος· καὶ ἰδοὺ ἠνεῴχθησαν οἱ οὐρανοί, καὶ εἶδεν πνεῦμα θεοῦ καταβαῖνον ὡσεὶ περιστερὰν ἐρχόμενον ἐπʼ αὐτόν·
paragraphs.translit: baptistheis de ho Iēsous euthys anebē apo tou hydatos· kai idou ēneōchthēsan hoi ouranoi, kai eiden pneuma theou katabainon hōsei peristeran erchomenon epʼ auton·

paragraphs.text: and lo, a voice out of the heavens, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἰδοὺ φωνὴ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν λέγουσα· Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν ᾧ εὐδόκησα.
paragraphs.translit: kai idou phōnē ek tōn ouranōn legousa· Houtos estin ho hyios mou ho agapētos, en hō eudokēsa.
